== DecipherCon 1999 photograph ==
Hall extra dested from [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]] (Decipher caption). [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 19:39, 25 October 2026 (UTC)

The fri30 still is dested as a group photograph. Decipher's caption names Tournaments Coordinator Bruce Umene doing the macarena while Aron Eisenberg signs. The standing man in the black shirt with his arm out is the lead crop.

Bill identified Jim Colson and Matt Sokol in the same still. The article does not name either face. Sokol is identified on the Wild Card hall still (beige cap, yellow shirt). The tall man in khaki pants next to the table is unnamed.
